claim: PJM's official Emergency Procedures dashboard now displays end times for previously unresolved Dominion Post Contingency Local Load Relief Warnings: Message 105574 ended at 23:32 EDT on October 14, 2026, and Message 105567 ended at 23:33 EDT. The same snapshot also displays 23:33 EDT end times for Messages 105569 and 105570. These are posting-state corrections only; they do not establish recipient acknowledgement, physical constraint resolution, customer consequence repair, or complete correction propagation.
falsifier: A later authoritative PJM record withdraws or corrects the displayed end times, or a preserved primary snapshot shows that the prior unresolved baseline already contained these end times.
firstUnsupportedArrow: Displayed PJM end time -> recipient acknowledgement -> operational release -> measured physical relief -> downstream consequence reconciliation
omissions: No recipient acknowledgement record was retrieved.
No measured post-warning facility loading or voltage record was retrieved.
No evidence establishes that every downstream system propagated the release.
No customer-impact or restoration record was retrieved.
The exact edit/posting time for each end-time field is not exposed by the dashboard.
No preserved raw prior snapshot for Message 105567 was available in the repository intake.
rivalHypotheses: The end times were entered contemporaneously after operators released the warnings.
The end times existed earlier but were omitted from a prior summary or inaccessible dashboard view.
The public dashboard changed after an internal operational release without exposing the propagation interval.
